articles.title: AI "Mind Viruses" Can Spread Between Agents Through Persistent Prompt Files
articles.plain_summary: Security researchers at Anthropic and Switzerland's EPFL have demonstrated that self-propagating payloads can spread from one artificial intelligence (AI) agent to the next through the editable system prompt files that autonomous agent harnesses use to carry state between sessions.
